verdict.rationale: AI Gateway documents a single dashboard with cost and token metrics, plus per-request logs that record provider, token usage and cost across multiple providers. That covers centralized, cross-provider spend visibility. Breakdown or attribution of spend by model, API key, team or user is not documented: budget limits per user, project or team in Dynamic Routing are enforcement, not spend tracking. missing for 10: documented spend aggregation by model, key, team and user, cost reporting or filtering by custom metadata, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can track spend per model, key, team, or user across all providers in one place

citations.quote: View metrics such as the number of requests, tokens, and the cost it takes to run your application.

Your AI Gateway dashboard shows logs of individual requests, including the user prompt, model response, provider, timestamp, request status, token usage, cost, duration, and the user agent of the client that made the request.
Connect to any model, dynamically route requests, and manage usage, billing, and logs from one unified gateway.
